clips.title: 欧洲航天CEO：马斯克是灵感，欧洲需缩小运输差距
title_lines: 欧洲需缩小太空运输差距

subtitles.en: So the transportation is what is very difficult to master, the highest barriers to entry, so very few are going to succeed. But once you have made it, you open space to, of course,
subtitles.zh: 运输是最难掌握的环节，进入门槛最高，所以成功者寥寥。但一旦成功，就能向各国开放太空。
zh_highlights: 运输是最难掌握的环节
en_highlights: transportation is what is very difficult to master

subtitles.en: you are but also as many nations as possible in our case. What does that full stack in space transportation look like? What is the cadence that you're targeting? So we've done things
subtitles.zh: 你们完整的太空运输体系是怎样的？目标发射频率如何？我们采取了不同的路径，

subtitles.en: a little bit the other way around, because we didn't start with a rocket. We started with the capsule. One reason for that is that Europe never had its own capsule. So every time I want to
subtitles.zh: 因为我们没有从火箭开始，而是从太空舱入手。原因之一是欧洲从未拥有自己的太空舱。

subtitles.en: fly an astronaut, we need to give cash to all the friends of SpaceX. And I kind of, hey, we could use that money to build the technology here and also to inspire people. What does Sovereign
subtitles.zh: 每次送宇航员，都要给SpaceX的伙伴们送钱。我想，这笔钱可以用来发展本土技术，激励民众。

subtitles.en: and Sovereign space mean to you? So it means for us in Europe the capacity to be a leading space
subtitles.zh: 主权太空对你意味着什么？对欧洲而言，就是凭借自身技术成为领先的太空国家。

subtitles.en: nation by with our own technologies. How big is the gap right now versus the US? The gap is significant. The gap is significant, especially in space transportation. We are very good in satellites.
subtitles.zh: 目前与美国的差距有多大？差距显著，尤其在太空运输领域。我们在卫星方面很强。

subtitles.en: But the gap is significant in space transportation. That's why we've also like, you know, we've been very focused on that because I want to have an impact where there is a gap basically
subtitles.zh: 但太空运输差距很大，所以我们专注于此，希望在差距领域发挥作用，助力欧洲主权。
en_highlights: gap is significant in space transportation

subtitles.en: and we can significantly contribute to this European sovereignty. The market is going to go towards very, very big launchers because on the demand side you have more satellite constellations,
subtitles.zh: 市场将趋向超大型运载火箭，因为需求端有更多卫星星座。
